key_point: Christmas Eve nearly ended No Man's Sky
title: Christmas Eve nearly ended No Man's Sky
caption: On Christmas Eve 2013, a flood destroyed most of the office of No Man's Sky studio Hello Games. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #nomanssky #hellogames

instagram.caption:
On Christmas Eve 2013, heavy rain made a river burst its banks in Guildford, England, flooding the office of Hello Games.

The small team lost most of their computers, furniture and concept art, right as No Man's Sky had just been revealed.

They saved most of the code, moved on and kept building. Years later the game is still getting free updates.

Do you still play No Man's Sky?
